text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
During a tranquil lunch break, as<n>clouds drift
peacefully across the<n>sky... the moment of truth
arrives.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Attention, all students! Starting today,<n>this academy
belongs to Wicked<n>Windy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy's grand academy<n>takeover plan has
begun!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"I've sealed off all the exits! If ya<n>want out, then
listen up real closely!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Solve all the puzzles and sniff out the<n>place where
I'm hidin'!<n>MWAHAHAHA!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It all seems very sudden... I can't<n>help but worry if
her plan is really<n>going to work.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! An escape game event! I love<n>this kinda
stuff!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Taiki! Taiki! I found a whole<n>bunch of black
envelopes in the<n>hallway. Let's open them up!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Eeek! It's a spider! ...Wait, this is just<n>a toy! Oh,
come on!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
That hallway's blocked off by a big<n>panel! Wow,
when did the school<n>have a chance to set all this
up?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you over there! It's fine to<n>enjoy yourselves,
but make sure you<n>don't get hurt!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I was prepared for a little<n>chaos after
learning what her plans<n>entailed, but this is far more
than I<n>had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
True enough—everyone is beside<n>themselves with
excitement... It's<n>frankly wonderful. Windy has
outstanding talent as an event<n>planner.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Though she seems unruly, she had<n>the foresight to
bring her plan to us<n>for approval to ensure we
wouldn't<n>rain on her parade.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
And I have to give her credit for her<n>risk
management skills. I guess all<n>those pranks she
pulls every day are<n>paying off, in a sense.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I hope this event turns out<n>splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Me too... Although it seems Windy<n>herself still sees
the whole thing as<n>no more than a giant prank.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the student council watching<n>over things,
Shinko Windy's grand<n>academy takeover plan
kicks into<n>high gear!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh! How was that? I bet<n>everyone was
super surprised!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rather than being surprised, it seems<n>most of the
students are having loads<n>of fun.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! Of course! What else would<n>ya expect?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Now let's see if any of<n>'em can actually
get their hands on<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy hides beneath the<n>staircase. After
around half an hour, I<n>hear footsteps closing in
rapidly!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gah!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Found you! She's over here!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Urk!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I admit... some of those puzzles were<n>real
head-scratchers, but brace<n>yourself! Now that
we've found you,<n>it's game over!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Heh. Hehehe! MWAHAHAHA!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You really think chumps like you can<n>catch Wicked
Windy?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy makes her daring<n>escape just as
more and more<n>students begin to arrive.

text_block_list.name: Crowd of Students
text_block_list.text: Stop, Windy!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: WAHAHAHA! Just try and catch me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She flashes them a great big smile<n>before
disappearing once again.

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Where is she?! Based on the puzzle,<n>she should be
in this area...

text_block_list.name: Classmate B
text_block_list.text:
Come out, Windy! You planted way<n>too many
jack-in-the-boxes<n>everywhere!

text_block_list.name: Classmate C
text_block_list.text: Hey, let's try searching over there!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Heh heh! Look at those chumps<n>scurryin' around!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: They're all desperately lookin' for<n>me!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Hey, Trainer! Let's move over<n>there next!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna give 'em a glimpse of me<n>and kick up
an even bigger<n>commotion! Heeheehee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she failed at her initial<n>objective—casting
the academy into<n>the depths of fear—Shinko Windy
thoroughly enjoys the event she<n>planned.
